notes.title: What is Calm Before the Storm?
notes.notes:
The name Calm Before the storm was inspired by Michael Wolf, A photographer in japan.

He did a year long project on the public transportation system in japan and how full it is.

And these photos really looked like a storm, a storm of people.

And the game's idea was what would happen before this storm of people.

A lonely Japanese cleaning employee came to mind.

Wiping the station clean and cleaning all the trash before the storm of people arrive.

Only for it to get back to the same condition after rush hour ends and station closes.

in this game you're experiencing that japanese cleaning employee's life.

You are the [b]Calm Before the Storm[/b].
